entry.title: Consumers want to feel the holiday spirit. A good store experience can help.
entry.summary: Minimizing fuss, helping customers keep their holiday traditions alive and righting any problems that come up will be key goals this year.

entry.title: Carter’s new chief product officer is from H&M
entry.summary: The children’s apparel retailer made a number of other leadership changes. Meanwhile, the company reported a "volatile” Q3, according to analysts.

entry.title: Shakeup at Old Navy continues amid merchandising struggles
entry.summary: Nicole Colombo, who led fashion at Walmart’s marketplace, is now head of women’s merchandising at Gap Inc.’s value brand.

entry.title: Boot Barn ramps up store openings despite lowering outlook
entry.summary: Warm weather impacted some sales in the second quarter, but the retailer is refreshing key assortments as it accelerates its footprint expansion.

entry.title: Holiday shoppers only want a dash of AI for the gift hunt
entry.summary: Price comparisons and narrowing down gift ideas are some of the ways consumers are using AI this season. But maintaining autonomy in the buying process remains important to shoppers.

entry.title: Why J.C. Penney is taking on deal fatigue for its holiday campaign
entry.summary: Marisa Thalberg, chief customer and marketing officer at parent Catalyst Brands, explains the retailer’s latest push with agency Mischief.

entry.title: Bed Bath & Beyond’s strategy needs a reset
entry.summary: The company, now known as Neighborhood Intelligence, relied on acquisitions to expand its business beyond retail. With two deals called off, where does that leave its turnaround?

entry.title: AI recommendations are leading to returns
entry.summary: The problem may not have to do with the technology itself, but rather the product description data, according to a new report.

entry.title: With new ownership, Lee eyes activewear and workwear
entry.summary: The denim label is officially part of the Authentic Brands Group stable and will expand into adjacent “lifestyle offerings.”

entry.title: At Home taps former CFO as new chief executive
entry.summary: Judd Nystrom returns to the company's C-suite several years after supporting its move into the public trading market.
